title: Seance — privacy demo
summary: Compare what strangers, recipients and auditors can learn from private Esmeralda payments. The creator’s v2 searches the latest 40 indexer transactions locally before asking for a user-entered ID; an explicit Ask for it anyway action can disclose that ID. The initial example remains a labeled saved October 20 copy. October 31 Summon inspection returned a current Commit receipt through a public indexer read. The page reported six requests to two hosts and zero ID requests; this is its own report, not an independent network audit. An optional Sapient transfer goes to a demonstration recipient whose view key is public. Timing, fees and spend links remain visible. Old transaction bodies are unavailable from the indexers; receipts alone cannot reverify their encrypted bytes. The recording covers the picker and request explanation without a wallet or payment. v1 remains at its earlier URL; this is distinct from DevXTools’ sealed polls.
cardSummary: Compare what strangers, recipients and auditors can read from private testnet payments, including the metadata that remains public.
